items: 2 new admissions in June 2021: Mstr. Arish Kaizad Karkaria and Mstr. Kaiwan Kurush Sidhwa.
Total Strength 2021-22: 23 students — 20 school + 3 college (Persheus Yezdi Turel, Std. XI; Shyamak Roomi Sanjana, Std. XII; Farzan Kurush Dastur, TYBCom).
Navar: Yazad J. Broacha, Hormazd K. Fatakia and Sharukh K. Karkaria, all in Mumbai (May).
Maratab: Karl Z. Sidhwa in Mumbai (April).
SSC 2022: Karl Z. Sidhwa (82.60%), Yazad J. Broacha (80.40%), Fravash M. Gulestan (77.40%). Er. Karl Sidhwa stood second in SSC among all Parsi students of the DPYA High School.
Annual exams were taken in an online mode.

On 13 June an online farewell party was organised for the outgoing SSC students, along with Empowering Mobeds. Dasturji Khurshed, Mr. Dinshaw Tamboly and the Principal addressed the students, and the 5 outgoing students gave brief farewell speeches. Games were organised by Mr. Arish S. Daruwalla, with prizes and gift vouchers given by Empowering Mobeds.
The Institute functioned in an online mode in the first term — tuitions, prayer classes and parent-teacher meetings were all held online.
An online creative workshop held by a reputed children's author was attended by most students.

In the second term the school and Institute worked partially with 9 senior students from Std. VIII to XI from November; it closed again for one month in January 2022 and resumed in physical mode for Std. V-X from February.
On 22 August two students, Er. Farmaan Sarosh Dastur and Er. Zahan Meherzad Turel, were scheduled speakers for the Ba-Humata Khordad Sal online programme.

On 6 September a “Nutri-Bag” of nutritious pulses and eatables was given to each student at a Central Government and Parzor programme in the Institute Hall, presided over by Mrs. Smriti Irani and Mr. Mukhtar Naqvi.
On 25 September the Dadar Athornan Institute was featured in Mazda Multimedia's bi-monthly YouTube programme “Our Very Own”.
On 3 October students attended a Zoom webinar on “Study Skills” conducted by Mrs. Kashmira Kakalia and facilitated by Empowering Mobeds.
